messages:
alex: Quick ping — PR #8421 has a microbatch alloc tweak. Canary shows a small regression, need quick eyes.

maria: can you paste the bench output or link it?

alex: paste below.

```text
benchmark: microbatch throughput (longseq, 2k tokens, batch=4)
master    : 1125 rps
pr-8421   : 1090 rps   (-3.1%)
mem p95   : master 1.90G, pr 2.05G (+7.9%)
lat p95   : master 42ms, pr 44ms (+4.8%)
runs: 3, averaged
```

sophia: is that from the longseq canary or the kv-heavy job?

alex: longseq canary ('longseq-microbatch-2026-03-17'), kv cache enabled.

derek: -3% throughput +8% mem is small but observable. CI noise? did you run multiple seeds?

alex: yes, three runs on the same infra, same queue. variance low across runs.

bench-bot: Canary run finished — allocations stable, no OOMs. Tail latencies flagged in 2 runs :warning:

maria: which files changed? can we bisect the alloc tweak?

alex: small edits in scheduler.rs and microbatcher.rs. main change is a prefetch/alloc heuristic.

sophia: quick experiment: gate the new prefetch when seq > 1024. that should avoid extra memory for longseq.

derek: i can try a revert of the alloc tweak and re-run the bench in ~30m. assign to me.

alex: assigning to @derek — thanks :pray:

maria: also consider adding a feature-flag so we can rollout safely.

alex: good call. will add a flag if revert shows improvement.

derek: starting run now (run id 42). ETA ~35m.

bench-bot: run queued on bench-pool-3, nodename infra-12.

[~35m later]

derek: results: reverted alloc tweak only.

```text
benchmark (revert)
master    : 1125 rps
pr-8421-revert : 1118 rps (-0.6%)
mem p95   : master 1.90G, pr-revert 1.92G (+1.1%)
lat p95   : master 42ms, pr-revert 42.5ms (+1.2%)
```

derek: looks within noise now.

maria: ok +1 on revert. alex, can you push guard instead of revert? small patch eg:

```rust
// in microbatcher.rs
if seq_len > 1024 {
    // disable aggressive prefetch
    prefetch = false;
}
```

alex: pushed patch with the seq>1024 guard and a feature flag `microbatch.prefetch_longseq=false`.

sophia: skimmed patch — lgtm.

maria: approved. leaving final +1.

alex: merging in 10m unless any objections. thanks all :rocket:

sophia: nice work, thx!

bench-bot: merge queued, will run post-merge smoke benchmarks.
